about: B: quest locations (search area, event spawn points, travel radii, markers, a border-watcher camp, blossoms)

entries.why: search area sat on Thorgil himself in Audliten; walkthrough 319: the house is east over the bridge, south of the road, where the scavengers are - the Norse House fixture at East Svealand 36350,32797 (zone 101 fixtures), 600 units from the tomte scavenger spawns
step-3 marker follows the search area to Thorgil's farmhouse (walkthrough 319)
the two traitor guards are met beside Castle Sauvage (region 1), not in Camelot (region 10): kill targets follow the event spawn; walkthrough 79

walkthrough 79: 'I found the 2 guards to the left of castle sauvage if you are facing it'; v2: the first point (Forest Sauvage 18000,58600) was at the castle wall, 1.2k inside the aggro range of its realm NPCs (Keep Sentinels, Master Wizards with range 2000, the blacksmith), who would kill the hostile traitors before the player; now the nearest flat ground clear of every guard's range by 1.6k, south-west of the castle at Forest Sauvage 15000,56250 (ebony fellwoods 1.6k away), trigger radius 600

set.StepText: Ask Erstal Furlan, the smith at Outland Wharf, about the shards of Sequence. (whisper: shards of Sequence)|Take the shard from the mud golem Dooben.|Show the shard to Erstal Furlan.|Slay the wood ogre seer Vagdush.|Combine the shard and the amulet at the forge in Ludlow.

entries.why: v2: the period (wayback Allakhazam quest 507, 2004 capture, pre-1.75) sends you to 'Erstal Furlan, the smith at Outland Wharf' (Avalon Marsh 37300,18240, 'inside the Outland Wharf'); our Erstal stands there (37291,18752). 'West Downs' was the post-1.75 text

step text says Gotar; period Ick lived in Gotar (Allakhazam Silkstrand Belt comments 2001-2002 '53299, 59311 in Gotar'; CapnBry 22 sightings zone 103 50-55k,52-61k); marker pointed at the post-1.75 East Svealand Ick
Public_DB Ick in East Svealand is the post-1.75 location (quest spec: 'Before 1.75 Ick lived in Gotar (moved to East Svealand in 1.75)'); the Gotar Ick (true165-prima-new) is the period one
